title: Digital receivable supplement processed successfully
description: Emitted as the contract_digital_receivable_supplement_processed_success event type when a contract operation is applied to the digital receivable supplement of a contract (Brazil-only): supplement creation on contract creation, supplement update or clearing on contract update, and contract termination. A supplement defines the rules (amounts, period, expiration days, face value range and debtors) under which future digital receivables are bound to the contract. One event is emitted per contract supplement and reflects the supplement state after the operation.

digital_receivable_supplement_id.title: Digital receivable supplement ID
digital_receivable_supplement_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v7) of the supplement, generated by Pismo when the supplement is created.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: Pismo-generated identifier of the contract that owns the supplement.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Operation identifier of the contract that owns the supplement, as informed when the contract was created.

total_amount.title: Total amount
total_amount.description: Total amount of the supplement in BRL with decimals, as defined on the contract.

available_balance.title: Available balance
available_balance.description: Remaining amount of the supplement in BRL with decimals that can still be consumed by digital receivables bound to the contract. On updates with balance capture enabled it is the previous available balance adjusted by the change in total_amount.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Start date of the supplement period, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: End date of the supplement period, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

min_expire_days.title: Minimum expire days
min_expire_days.description: Minimum number of days until maturity that a digital receivable must have to be covered by the supplement.

max_expire_days.title: Maximum expire days
max_expire_days.description: Maximum number of days until maturity that a digital receivable may have to be covered by the supplement.

min_face_value.title: Minimum face value
min_face_value.description: Minimum face value in BRL with decimals that a digital receivable must have to be covered by the supplement.

max_face_value.title: Maximum face value
max_face_value.description: Maximum face value in BRL with decimals that a digital receivable may have to be covered by the supplement.

debtors.title: Debtors
debtors.description: Debtors included in or excluded from the supplement scope, as stored on the supplement. Absent when the supplement has no debtors.

document_number.title: Debtor document number
document_number.description: Document number of the debtor, either CPF or CNPJ, as informed on the contract.

document_number_prefix.title: Debtor document number prefix
document_number_prefix.description: First eight digits (CNPJ root) of the debtor document number. Present only when the debtor is identified by CNPJ; absent for CPF debtors.

operation_type.title: Debtor operation type
operation_type.description: Whether the debtor is part of the supplement scope, validated against the debtor OperationType enum on the contract API. INCL: The debtor is included in the supplement scope. EXCL: The debtor is excluded from the supplement scope.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: Document number (CPF or CNPJ) of the lender stored on the supplement.

creditor_document_number.title: Creditor document number
creditor_document_number.description: Document number of the contract creditor, taken from the contract that owns the supplement.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Domain operation that triggered the event, taken from the originating contract command. CREATE_CONTRACT: Contract creation. UPDATE_CONTRACT: Contract update, including inclusion, change, exclusion and renegotiation. DELETE_CONTRACT: Contract termination. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act creation. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act update. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act termination.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specialization of feature_type, serialized from the OperationType enum. Contract flows use CREATE_CONTRACT on creation, UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE or UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL on update, and CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD or CLOSING_RNGC on termination according to the termination reason.
